svg.title: Sheet 3 of 6, detail B, AI systems, with an illustrated eye-openness trace that raises a spoken alert on a drowsy dip: EyeDTrack, driver attention monitoring, thesis and solo rebuild. 713 milliseconds from camera capture to result at the 95th percentile, on one phone at a desk in November 2026; 1,200+ automated checks on the server, the app and the phone; 26 of 30 yawn alerts were real yawns, an idealized episode count from a sealed final test that met 0 of its 15 accuracy targets. Thesis team lead, then sole developer of the rebuild; Kotlin, Python, Flask and MySQL; dlib's 68 facial landmarks and OpenCV; 2025, and October to November 2026.
svg.text: Driver attention monitoring, thesis and solo rebuild
